title: 交易脈動：Baseline 卡片不再印 not_required 原字串，Sharpe 樣本累積中要明說
hosted_verification_note: Verified locally via Vitest unit/component/i18n tests, TypeScript application and Agora typechecks, contract drift checks, ESLint, Vite production build, and headless Chromium browser screenshots + DOM readbacks of /management/trading-pulse using fixture data in zh-TW and en-US. Hosted environment was not touched.

acceptance_criteria.1_baseline_card_not_required_localized_a: verified: compactCounts accepts an optional formatKey function passed on the Baseline Comparison card status line (line 1776 of src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx) mapping 'not_required' to t('mgmt.pulse.notRequired') ('不需比較' in zh-TW, 'Not required' in en-US), and the raw string 'not_required' no longer appears anywhere on the page.
acceptance_criteria.2_other_baseline_status_keys_unchanged: verified: Keys other than 'not_required' (such as 'ok', 'watch', 'breached', 'unavailable') return the key unchanged from the formatKey callback and render as they do today.
acceptance_criteria.3_shared_compact_counts_lines_unchanged: verified: The byStatus, byStage, and rowHealth lines call compactCounts without formatKey and render identically to today.
acceptance_criteria.4_sharpe_leaders_empty_shows_building_hi: verified: When b.kind === 'sharpe-leaders' and rows are empty, RankingBlocks renders t('mgmt.pulse.sharpeBuildingHistory') ('樣本累積中：至少需要 10 個交易日的日報酬才會計算 Sharpe' in zh-TW, 'Building history: Sharpe needs at least 10 daily returns' in en-US) instead of t('mgmt.pulse.noRows').
acceptance_criteria.5_sharpe_leaders_missing_badge_neutral_t: verified: When b.kind === 'sharpe-leaders' and missingMetricCount > 0, RankingBlocks renders the badge with statusTone('building') ('bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border') and t('mgmt.pulse.sharpeBuildingBadge') ('累積中: <count>' in zh-TW, 'Building: <count>' in en-US) instead of the degraded metricMissing badge.
acceptance_criteria.6_sharpe_leaders_rows_render_existing_ma: verified: When the sharpe-leaders block has rows, RankingBlocks takes the non-empty branch and renders each row through the existing <ul>/<li>/<Link> markup.
acceptance_criteria.7_other_ranking_blocks_keep_degraded_bad: verified: Ranking blocks with b.kind !== 'sharpe-leaders' keep statusTone('degraded') ('bg-status-warning/15 text-status-warning border-status-warning/30'), t('mgmt.pulse.metricMissing'), and t('mgmt.pulse.noRows') when empty.
acceptance_criteria.8_focused_tests_i18n_parity_and_typechec: verified: Focused tests in src/management/pages/oversight/TradingPulsePage.test.tsx (7 tests), src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts (10 tests), npm run typecheck:app, and npm run typecheck:agora all pass.
acceptance_criteria.9_evidence_records_commands_results_and_: verified: Exact commands, exit codes, test counts, and 1440x1200 headless Chromium screenshots + DOM readbacks of /management/trading-pulse in zh-TW and en-US using fixture data are recorded below.
